title: The Zeal of Phinehas

questions.question: While Israel lived in Shittim, what did the people begin to do?
options: Whore with the daughters of Moab
questions.correctAnswer: Whore with the daughters of Moab
questions.explanation: Numbers 25:1 (ESV): "While Israel lived in Shittim, the people began to whore with the daughters of Moab."

questions.question: Which god did Israel yoke itself to?
questions.explanation: Numbers 25:3 (ESV): "So Israel yoked himself to Baal of Peor."

questions.question: What did God tell Moses to do to the chiefs of the people?
options: Hang them in the sun before the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Hang them in the sun before the Lord
questions.explanation: Numbers 25:4 (ESV): "Take all the chiefs of the people and hang them in the sun before the Lord..."

questions.question: Who saw an Israelite man bring a Midianite woman to his family and took action?
questions.explanation: Numbers 25:7 (ESV): "When Phinehas the son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, saw it..."

questions.question: What did Phinehas do?
options: Pierced both of them through with a spear
questions.correctAnswer: Pierced both of them through with a spear
questions.explanation: Numbers 25:8 (ESV): "And pierced both of them, the man of Israel and the woman, through her belly."

questions.question: What happened as a result of Phinehas' action?
options: The plague on the people of Israel was stopped
questions.correctAnswer: The plague on the people of Israel was stopped
questions.explanation: Numbers 25:8 (ESV): "Thus the plague on the people of Israel was stopped."

questions.question: How many died in the plague by Baal of Peor?
questions.explanation: Numbers 25:9 (ESV): "Nevertheless, those who died by the plague were 24,000."

questions.question: What covenant did God make with Phinehas?
questions.explanation: Numbers 25:13 (ESV): "And it shall be to him... the covenant of a perpetual priesthood, because he was jealous for his God..."

questions.question: What was the name of the Israelite man killed?
questions.explanation: Numbers 25:14 (ESV): "The name of the slain man of Israel... was Zimri the son of Salu..."

questions.question: What was the name of the Midianite woman?
questions.explanation: Numbers 25:15 (ESV): "The name of the Midianite woman who was killed was Cozbi the daughter of Zur..."

questions.question: What did God command Moses regarding the Midianites?
options: "Harass the Midianites and strike them down"
questions.correctAnswer: "Harass the Midianites and strike them down"
questions.explanation: Numbers 25:17 (ESV): "Harass the Midianites and strike them down."

questions.question: Why did God command to strike the Midianites?
options: Because they have harassed you with their wiles (Peor incident)
questions.correctAnswer: Because they have harassed you with their wiles (Peor incident)
questions.explanation: Numbers 25:18 (ESV): "For they have harassed you with their wiles... in the matter of Peor..."

questions.question: Zizri was a chief of a father's house from which tribe?
questions.explanation: Numbers 25:14 (ESV): "...chief of a father's house belonging to the Simeonites."

questions.question: Zur (father of Cozbi) was what?
questions.explanation: Numbers 25:15 (ESV): "Who was the tribal head of a father's house in Midian."

questions.question: Phinehas turned back God's...?
questions.explanation: Numbers 25:11 (ESV): "Phinehas... has turned back my wrath from the people of Israel."

key_verse_text: Phinehas the son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, has turned back my wrath from the people of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them...
